name: Pangolin Site (CLI)
description: Dedicated Pangolin Site LXC using the official CLI (`pangolin up site`, Newt embedded). Connects outbound to expose private resources without port forwarding.

notes.text: Create the site in the Pangolin dashboard first, then copy the Site ID, secret, and endpoint. Unattended: `var_site_id=ID var_site_secret=SECRET var_pangolin_endpoint=URL`.
TUN passthrough, nesting, and keyctl are on by default (override `var_tun=no`, `var_nesting=0`). Site mode is userspace WireGuard; prefer this LXC over a host install.
IPv4 forwarding and NAT masquerade are configured inside the container and persist. Add host/LAN routes to this CT's IP for bidirectional tunnel routing.
No web UI. Status: `systemctl status pangolin-site` (Debian) or `rc-service pangolin-site status` (Alpine). Update: `/usr/bin/update` or `pct exec <CTID> -- update`.
Site tunnel only. For a host or existing LXC, or machine-client mode, use the Pangolin Addon. Existing Newt LXCs migrate in place on their next update.
